## Selected commentary

::: {.commentary-list}
::: {.commentary-item}
<p class="commentary-date">2026 · VoxDev</p>

### [How can countries develop their economies in a changed world?](https://voxdev.org/topic/macroeconomics-growth/how-can-countries-develop-their-economies-changed-world)

With Francesco Caselli, revisiting how protectionism, automation, climate change, and state capacity alter the development strategies available to lower-income economies.
:::

::: {.commentary-item}
<p class="commentary-date">2024 · International Growth Centre</p>

### [India's Opportunity for Sustainable Growth](https://www.theigc.org/blogs/climate-priorities-developing-countries/indias-opportunity-sustainable-growth)

With Nikita Sharma, on how clean-energy and conservation innovations can loosen the historical trade-off between growth and environmental protection.
:::

::: {.commentary-item}
<p class="commentary-date">2023 · International Growth Centre / LSE Business Review</p>

### [How Investing in Human Capital Can Help Adapt to Climate Change](https://www.theigc.org/blogs/climate-priorities-developing-countries/how-investing-human-capital-can-help-adapt-climate)

Why education can make workers more mobile across sectors and locations—and therefore more resilient to climate damage.
:::

::: {.commentary-item}
<p class="commentary-date">2023 · International Growth Centre</p>

### [Eight Questions for Sustainable Growth](https://www.theigc.org/blogs/climate-priorities-developing-countries/eight-questions-sustainable-growth)

With Allegra Saggese, Robin Burgess, and Stefano Caria, on energy, firms, cities, social protection, climate finance, and the next research agenda.
:::

::: {.commentary-item}
<p class="commentary-date">2016 · International Growth Centre</p>

### [Transforming Myanmar's Energy Sector](https://eprints.lse.ac.uk/81709/1/Transforming%20Myanmar%E2%80%99s%20energy%20sector%20-%20IGC.pdf)

On electricity access, generation choices, and the pricing reforms needed to finance a reliable power system.
:::
